positions.description:
ETA Engineering
• Developed a tool to adjust delivery ETA pads
• Created new gRPC endpoints to kickstart a new framework to facilitate ETA padding adjustments
• Enhanced a Kotlin backend microservice and Redis cache that stores ETA pads
• Built the frontend for a A/B testing tool using React

Ad Platforms Engineering Team
• Contributed the refactoring a large scale Java Spring Boot backend

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
AI 4 AV Research Group
• Coauthored findings at 2020 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
• Utilize machine learning and supercomputing resources to generate metadata for audio and video material
• Classify interviews with a BERT model using Pandas and NumPy to preprocess data and TensorFlow and Keras to model the text
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Machine Learning · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Platform Engineering Team
• Wrote a Python script that was used to automate the tagging of thousands of AWS S3 resources to maintain compliance with Fidelity standard
• Built an AWS Lambda application that identified and decrypted parameters of ECS Task Definitions for improved visibility and analysis
• Developed a Boto3 Python program that lists the allocated memory and CPU of ECS Clusters to optimize the efficiency of resources
• Packaged and deployed applications to the cloud using Docker, UrbanCode Deploy, and AWS Cloudformation
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda
